_comment: #256 Phase B, CORRECTED (correction round 2, 2026-08-04): the original _comment here cited 'Screenshot 2026-08-04 at 16.24.40.png' (imported hash omitted here on purpose -- see pro-tour-las-vegas.json's own _comment for it, since re-citing it in BOTH files is exactly the circularity this correction fixes) as a third Edinburgh capture -- that file is UNAMBIGUOUSLY a Pro Tour Las Vegas capture (teal mat, gold 'Pro Tour Las Vegas' branding in both sidebars, TCGplayer sponsor block -- confirmed by direct visual inspection of the full-resolution PNG, and cited correctly as evidence in pro-tour-las-vegas.json's own _comment). Citing it here too meant one of Edinburgh's 3 'cross-validation' captures was secretly a different rig, and made the two configs' agreement partly circular (a shared input frame agrees with itself by construction, not by evidence). Replaced with a genuinely different Edinburgh capture, each source individually verified by viewing the full-resolution PNG (white/lavender mat, 'EDINBURGH' text in the left info-stack, 'CALLING' branding on the mat itself), not inferred from filename timestamp patterns alone: sourceFile 'Screenshot 2026-08-04 at 13.22.39.png' (imported as 4447be80b29fad67.png, 2048x1154, Quarters -- Pablo Pintor vs Daniel Correas, Turn 16), 'Screenshot 2026-08-04 at 13.23.05.png' (3422b51d3a470ded.png, 2048x1160, same Quarters match, Turn 15), and 'Screenshot 2026-08-04 at 13.26.38.png' (4de514cf8861e840.png, 2048x1149, a GENUINELY different match -- Finals, Jacob Clements vs Evan Tanguy, Turn 8 -- included specifically to check the geometry generalizes across match state, not just within one clip; shares zero captures with pro-tour-las-vegas.json's own evidence set). Re-measured this session via targeted pixel-transition scans (locating the white seam-line + dark border + stable mat-color run at each play-area edge, printed per-pixel RGB values, not a downscaled-thumbnail eyeball) at multiple rows/columns per capture: top edge 0.054-0.060, left edge 0.190-0.196, right edge 0.806-0.812 across all 3 -- matches the ORIGINAL committed playArea numbers below (0.058/0.196/0.809) within ~1%, so the geometry itself was already correct; only the evidence citation was wrong. The webcam/info-stack/card-preview SUB-splits within each sidebar are a secondary, lower-stakes visual estimate against the same (corrected) captures (a labeled synthetic card must never land inside the 'sidebar' kind region at all -- THAT boundary is the rigorously measured one; the further sub-split into webcam vs. info/preview bands only affects where cosmetic chrome placeholder art is drawn, not card placement or labeling).
